steps.say: Look at the picture first. Think about what you can say about it.
Start every sentence with a capital letter. End it with a full stop.
Say your sentence in your head before you write it down.
Check your spelling. Sound out each word slowly.
Plan with a beginning, a middle and an end. Read your writing again and fix mistakes.
In a journal, use time words like first, then and after that.

hints: Think about what helps you most.
Look back at the steps in this lesson.
Try each choice. Which one makes sense?
check.explanation: Capital letter at the start, full stop at the end.
